query: PDIA1 is the major ER oxidoreductase in the majority of mammalian cells, including ß cells. Here, using ß cell specific Pdia1 deletion we show that PDIA1 is increasingly important for insulin production in the face of either age or metabolic stress imposed by a HFD.
